name: N3-Tree
definition: Octrees and their generalization N3-trees (N subdivisions per node) are considered a special case of Kd-Trees. No algorithm in available literature proposes to exploit the specific structure of octrees to accelerate ray traversal.
summary: The N3-Tree is a sparse pointer octree for GPU volume rendering that stores data in 3D textures, using an alpha channel to distinguish leaf nodes containing values from internal nodes containing child pointers.
